blueprint.name: BNK 2.3 Platform (IBM ROKS)
blueprint.description: Install the BNK 2.3 platform onto an existing IBM ROKS cluster: cert-manager, F5 Lifecycle Operator, CNEInstance, and the BNK License.

outcomes: Existing IBM ROKS cluster referenced by name or ID
cert-manager installed with its CRDs registered
F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) installed and bound to an IBM IAM trusted profile
CNEInstance deployed with TMM/Helm pods Ready
BNK License CR applied using the JWT from IBM COS

prerequisites.description: An existing IBM ROKS cluster reachable from the project. Use the 'IBM ROKS Cluster' blueprint to provision one if you don't have it yet.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud credential template that supplies the API key, default resource group, and the COS instance reference used to pull the FAR auth key + license JWT.

prerequisites.name: bigip_password
prerequisites.description: BIG-IP admin password used by the FLO CIS controller. Stored encrypted in project secrets and injected at apply time — never serialized into terraform.tfvars.json or task output.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Select the project (which auto-fills IBM credentials, region, and resource group from its credential template), supply the existing ROKS cluster name or ID, and the BIG-IP URL/user. Everything else flows from the credential template, project secrets, and platform defaults.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region of the existing ROKS cluster.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Existing IBM ROKS cluster name or ID.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used for cluster discovery. Inherits from the IBM credential template, falls back to 'default'.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_instance_name
optional.description: IBM COS instance that holds the FLO FAR auth key and license JWT. Inherits from the IBM credential template.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: BIG-IP URL used by the FLO CIS controller (e.g. https://10.0.0.1).

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: BIG-IP username used by the FLO CIS controller.

modules.name: ROKS Cluster Register
modules.description: Resolve an existing IBM ROKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.

modules.name: cert-manager
modules.description: Install cert-manager into the registered ROKS cluster.

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Install FLO into the registered ROKS cluster after cert-manager is ready.

modules.name: CNEInstance
modules.description: Deploy a CNEInstance once FLO is ready. flo_trusted_profile_id and flo_cluster_issuer_name are auto-wired from the FLO module's outputs by the dependency graph.

modules.name: BNK License
modules.description: Apply the BNK License CR after CNEInstance is up. Pulls the F5 subscription JWT from the configured IBM COS bucket.
